result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, with the same options and behaviour. The cli module compiles and packages offline. I could not run the jar to check the help text, because the sandbox refused to execute it. The cli module has no tests, so nothing else was run. Nothing is committed.

- **`Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. Both landscape commands are in the no-argument usage overview.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names dispatch to the existing `updateLandscape` method. `-help` prints the name the user typed, with its matching description.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section covering both names.
